title: CDIF Access
description:
Profile module for machine-actionable access and usage conditions, expressed as ODRL Offer policies (odrlProperties/odrlOffer). Marks the catalog record as conformant to the CDIF access spec and requires at least one policy, attached in either of two places:
- on a schema:distribution item, as odrl:hasPolicy: the preferred place,
  because distributions of one dataset can carry different conditions
  (cdifbook data_access, "Connecting CDIF and ODRL"). The Offer may be
  inline or an {@id} reference.

- on the Dataset, as an {@id} reference in schema:conditionsOfAccess to
  a policy published elsewhere. Only a reference: cdifCore types the
  items of that property as string, {@id} or a CreativeWork link, and an
  inline Offer matches none of them, so it would fail any composite that
  includes cdifCore.

This module adds constraints only; it does not change cdifCore's schema:distribution anyOf [DataDownload, WebAPI]. Draft; OPEN QUESTIONS are marked "OPEN:".

dcterms:conformsTo.description: OPEN: https://w3id.org/cdif/access/1.1 is not minted. 1.1 follows the other CDIF modules; a new profile might start at 1.0 instead.

schema:conditionsOfAccess.description: Item shape comes from cdifCore. In a CDIF Access record, an {@id} item here should be the uid of an ODRL Offer; JSON Schema cannot tell that reference from any other (a SHACL rule would have to).

odrl:hasPolicy.description: ODRL policies governing access to and use of this distribution. OPEN: the book argues against dataset-level policies, so odrl:hasPolicy is not declared on the Dataset; confirm.
